cim: Is AI Helping or Hurting Numismatics?
cim_eredeti: Is AI Helping or Hurting Numismatics?
szoveg_eredeti:
(Orlando, Florida) November 19, 2026 – What are the effects of the explosive growth of AI technology on numismatics?

The Professional Numismatists Guild (www.PNGdealers.org) will host an educational symposium, “Artificial Intelligence and Numismatics,” on Wednesday, January 6, 2027, at the Florida United Numismatists (www.FUNtopics.com) convention. The program begins at 12:30 pm in room N320E in the North/South Building of the Orange County Convention Center in Orlando.

The symposium is open to PNG members as well as non-PNG dealers. A complimentary lunch will be available.

“Artificial Intelligence is transforming the way businesses operate, and the numismatic industry is no exception! From advancements in coin identification and authentication to innovative business applications, AI is opening the door to new opportunities while raising important questions about the future of our hobby and profession,” explained PNG Executive Director John Feigenbaum.

“Whether you are already exploring AI technology or simply curious about how it may shape the future of numismatics, this symposium promises to offer valuable insights and thought-provoking discussion,” said PNG President John Brush.

Feigenbaum and Jeff Garrett, a former PNG President, will lead the symposium.

Other participants include software engineer Aiden Feigenbaum, Co-Founder of RealAnalytica in New York, who will talk about the ways Whitman Publishing is using AI. Rare coin dealers Noah Lehmann-Haupt, Founder of Rarity7 in San Francisco, and Ron Guth, Proprietor of GermanCoins.com in San Diego and a former President of Professional Coin Grading Service, will speak about how they use AI in their companies.

The nonprofit Professional Numismatists Guild was founded in 1955. For additional information about the symposium and PNG, visit online at www.PNGdealers.org. You can also contact PNG by phone at 951-587-8300 or by email at info@PNGdealers.org.
